summary.text: Carrie Sorensen is the incumbent Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She has represented the district since December 2024 and works as a physical therapist, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Sorensen was born in Nashua, New Hampshire.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Syracuse University and a clinical doctorate from Long Island University.
Her career experience includes working as a physical therapist.
She won the 2024 general election for the seat, defeating Sue Polidura.
